items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: About 12 o'clock Ethel Waters got tired of jumping up every now and then, doing a song.

ctx.x: See, so, he said, 'Sam, you can bring a band in here.' I had about, let's see, I had five, six musicians at that time. He said, 'Come on in here and find me some girls that are good entertainers. And a man to go along with them.' So, that's when I picked up the two Ethels and another girl named Izzy Ringgold, which was a very good dancer and singer. In fact, she outsung most of the girls at that time. She was very good. And then I had a fellow called Snow Fisher.

Well, we worked all the summer. And, of course, being in the heart of town, there wasn't no laying off. You had to keep the music going all the time. Often, I'd keep the music going. So one night we started in at 9 o'clock. About 12 o'clock Ethel Waters got tired of jumping up every now and then, doing a song. So she said to Sam, 'Why don't you go an' urinate,
relieve yourself." She said, because, "And take a rest, because I'm tired of singing."
